items.lang|tensura_guild|task.tensura_guild.ki: Charybdis can tear apart trade routes and settlement defenses with violent winds. Solo adventurers or parties may accept this commission. Defeat 1 Charybdis, then return to submit it.
Beast Gnome disrupts earth-aspected magicules, putting nearby mines and roads at risk of collapse. Defeat 1 Beast Gnome, then return to submit it.
Ifrit's heat can trigger wide-area fires, and the guild needs it suppressed immediately. Defeat 1 Ifrit, then return to submit it.
Akash causes unstable magicule reactions that are already disrupting survey teams. Defeat 1 Akash, then return to submit it.
Undine can block roads with freezing currents and threaten riverside outposts. Defeat 1 Undine, then return to submit it.
Sylphide creates dangerous turbulence that disrupts aerial patrols and caravan movement. Defeat 1 Sylphide, then return to submit it.

Ashlord's flames are powerful enough to turn towers, stockades, and entire camps into a burning ruin. The guild wants this infernal dragon cut down before another frontier outpost is lost. Defeat 1 Infernal Dragon, then return to submit it.

Sirok prowls beneath the dunes, dragging caravans under the sand and erupting without warning. Merchants are already avoiding the route, and the guild needs the giant sandworm dealt with. Defeat 1 Sandworm, then return to submit it.

Skor's freezing storms and crushing strength can lock down mountain passes in a single night. If left alone, the frost yeti will cut off supply lines to every nearby settlement. Defeat 1 Yeti, then return to submit it.

Nerakyss commands the sea around its ship like a living disaster, tearing apart hulls and dragging whole crews below the waves. This is an S-rank maritime extermination with a high casualty risk. Defeat 1 Kraken, then return to submit it.

A mature fire dragon can reduce villages, roosts, and treasure roads to molten wreckage in a single raid. The guild needs it brought down before the region is scorched clean. Defeat 1 Fire Dragon, then return to submit it.
